context: Pin both defects with failing tests, then guard the empty top slice with a width fallback and replace the argv coalescing with an explicit None check.
description: Two defects in _project/scripts/check_complexity.py from the 2026-08-09 adversarial review of PR #1644, deferred at merge without a tracker record. First, _print_report computes max() over the empty top slice, so --top 0 raises ValueError instead of printing a zero-row report (line 451). Second, main() uses argv or sys.argv[1:], so an explicitly passed empty argument list falls back to the process argv (line 522) and a programmatic main([]) parses foreign options such as pytest flags. Both are the falsy-coalescing defect class this repository's own quality batch banned.

anti_patterns.instead: Handle the empty slice with a width fallback and print zero rows.
anti_patterns.why: Zero is a valid requested row count for a summary-only report.

anti_patterns.dont: Use truthiness to distinguish None from an empty argument list.
anti_patterns.instead: Use sys.argv slice only when argv is None.
anti_patterns.why: An empty list is a valid explicit argument vector.

preserves.behavior: Command-line invocation via make targets behaves identically.
Default report output and exit semantics for --top greater than zero are unchanged.
The measured complexity policy and hard ceiling are unchanged.

prior_art.concept: Live measured complexity checker introduced by PR #1644.

verifications.expected: Exits nonzero with ValueError on the unfixed tree; exits 0 after the repair.

verifications.command: uv run -- python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '_project/scripts'); import check_complexity; sys.argv = ['check_complexity.py', '--definitely-invalid-flag']; raise SystemExit(check_complexity.main([]))"
verifications.description: main with an explicit empty list ignores process argv
verifications.expected: Exits nonzero on the unfixed tree because the foreign flag is parsed; exits 0 after the repair by running with pure defaults.
All checker tests pass including the two new regression cases.

work_units.summary: Pin the --top 0 ValueError and the main empty-list argv fallback in failing regression tests
Implement the empty-slice width fallback and the explicit None check for argv
Restore each defect as a negative control, prove its regression test fails, then restore the fix
